{
  "name": "@bull-board/ui",
  "version": "9.10.5",
  "description": "A Dashboard UI built on top of bull or bullmq.",
  "keywords": [
    "bull",
    "bullmq",
    "dashboard",
    "monitoring",
    "queue",
    "redis"
  ],
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": "felixmosh",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/felixmosh/bull-board.git",
    "directory": "packages/ui"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "typings"
  ],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "rsbuild dev",
    "build": "rsbuild build",
    "build:analyze": "RSDOCTOR=true rsbuild build",
    "clean": "rm -rf dist",
    "test": "jest",
    "sync:locales": "i18next-locales-sync -c ./localesSync.config.js",
    "gen:jsonSchema": "npm run gen:jsonSchema:bullmq && npm run gen:jsonSchema:bull",
    "gen:jsonSchema:bullmq": "npx ts-json-schema-generator --path '../../node_modules/bullmq/dist/esm/interfaces/**/*.ts' --type 'JobsOptions' --out './src/schemas/bullmq/jobOptions.json'",
    "gen:jsonSchema:bull": "npx ts-json-schema-generator --path '../../node_modules/bull/*.ts' --type 'Bull.JobOptions' --out './src/schemas/bull/jobOptions.json'"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@bull-board/api": "9.10.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@base-ui/react": "^1.8.0",
    "@codemirror/autocomplete": "^6.20.3",
    "@codemirror/commands": "^6.11.1",
    "@codemirror/lang-json": "^6.0.2",
    "@codemirror/language": "^6.12.4",
    "@codemirror/lint": "^6.9.7",
    "@codemirror/state": "^6.7.6",
    "@codemirror/view": "^6.43.13",
    "@lezer/common": "^1.5.3",
    "@rsbuild/core": "^2.2.10",
    "@rsbuild/plugin-react": "^2.1.1",
    "@rsbuild/plugin-type-check": "^1.6.0",
    "@rsdoctor/rspack-plugin": "^1.6.4",
    "@tanstack/react-query": "^5.104.0",
    "@testing-library/dom": "^10.4.2",
    "@testing-library/react": "^16.3.3",
    "@testing-library/user-event": "^14.6.7",
    "@types/jest": "^30.0.0",
    "@types/react": "^19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "@types/react-paginate": "^7.1.4",
    "@types/react-router-dom": "^5.3.3",
    "@xyflow/react": "^12.12.0",
    "axios": "^1.20.0",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "codemirror-json-schema": "^0.8.1",
    "date-fns": "4.4.0",
    "highlight.js": "^11.12.0",
    "i18next": "^26.4.2",
    "i18next-hmr": "^3.2.0",
    "i18next-http-backend": "^4.0.2",
    "i18next-locales-sync": "^3.0.4",
    "identity-obj-proxy": "^3.0.0",
    "jest": "^30.5.2",
    "jest-environment-jsdom": "^30.5.2",
    "json-schema-library": "^9.3.5",
    "lucide-react": "^1.48.0",
    "nanoid": "^6.0.2",
    "pretty-bytes": "^7.2.0",
    "react": "^19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "react-i18next": "^17.0.15",
    "react-json-view-lite": "^2.5.0",
    "react-paginate": "^8.3.0",
    "react-router-dom": "^5.3.4",
    "recharts": "^3.10.1",
    "ts-jest": "^29.4.14",
    "zustand": "5.0.15"
  }
}
